images.what: Illustrative photo: A high view from a window over a square in autumn, with yellow trees in the foreground, a street with cars and a blue pickup, green containers, white tents, a stage, a white faceted structure, an Airstream trailer and a scaffold tower with the letters IF and TIME, two red and white chimneys and long factory buildings behind, and many small figures far away

Illustrative photo: A tower of scaffolding hung with colored panels and large letters, among them a pink and blue question mark, stands on a paved square with people seated at wooden tables and stumps at the lower left, a glass-walled cabin glowing at the right, white balloons and a chimney behind

A tall hall hung with black and white patterned fabric panels, with a mannequin in a dress of the same print at the center, a metal sign reading Zeeuws Museum Handwerk, two small screens showing green garments, a jute bag hanging on a rope and a wooden bench with a black bin, and two visitors at the right edge

A close view of a mannequin's torso in a dark purple shirt, with a vertical strip of five small black circuit boards joined by white connectors and fine white threads trailing from them, against a red background

A tall black sign lined with orange bulbs reads vpro peepshow above portraits of people in gold frames, one wearing a VR headset, beside a red wall with a door and a handwritten note; a woman in a black and white zebra-print coat stands by the door looking back, with a red carpet and a white canopy overhead

A dark gallery with a brick wall and a framed poster at the left, a red glazed bowl and a small gray lamp on a white plinth, and at the right a red wool coat on a mannequin arm beside a tall wooden frame with blue, red and yellow panels; a visitor in a gray coat bends forward to look, with the face hidden by hair

A walkway along a pale factory wall beneath a rack of pipes, with adult visitors walking toward an entrance marked by white posts and an orange barrier that reads ENTRANCE, and pink markers numbered 21 on the glass

A bright white hall with a dark, rough-textured table topped by a long glass case holding clay-colored and golden objects, with bottles in cubbyholes below, and about ten adult visitors at mid distance around hanging lamps and glass panels

Illustrative photo: A glass case on a steel table holds what looks like a gray bird hung on wires and a small white branch-shaped piece, with a printed card reading OXI and SALUTES beside it, in front of hanging green strand curtains
Illustrative photo: A close view of a high-heeled shoe in white felt with a black heel and a thin gold strap, next to a dark felt shoe, with two visitors out of focus behind them

A place setting seen from above on a red and orange wax-print cloth, with a gray plate arranged into a smiling face with an orange mouth, small cups, cutlery and glasses
A dark hall hung with flags and glass, with large round tables laid with rows of glasses under a few white pendant lamps, and a person at a far counter

A shelf of speckled plates, cups and bowls in cream and gray, with a small white chair model and gray and pink notebooks, against a dark wall
A glass tube light seen from below in a dark hall, its pale glass fins and brass tips spreading like a bird's wings in front of a brick wall and a window with a sign

A high black hall with an acoustic ceiling and spotlights hung with clear and blue glass bulbs and a pink-orange glass piece, with a man in a blue jacket and a woman photographing the bulbs at mid distance and rows of chairs behind
A close view of rough clay-colored bell-shaped forms trailing rope, with two people walking in motion blur in a white corridor behind them

A tall view in a bright hall with a sign reading SPACE FARMING at the back, two visitors leaning over a long, thin truss model that carries a tray of pumpkins, and a screen and drawing on a white table in front
A corner room of a villa with floral wallpaper, wooden window frames, stained glass and a parquet floor, holding mirror-steel plinths, small white tables and a white sculpted leg on a patch of gravel
A tall timber hall with a plywood back wall, a grandfather clock, pink-lit beams and colored objects on gray plinths
Under a glass roof, round tables hold landscape models in green wool, wood and dark inlay, with boards headed Possible Landscapes, Urban and Rural behind them
Two visitors seen from behind stand in front of a large lit yellow textile work on a white wall, with a dark branching sculpture at the right
Glass-walled exhibition cases in a dim hall under blue light
Illustrative photo: A close view of timber beams edged in glowing pink, with a thin white light strip along one beam and a steel bracket at a joint, in a tall hall with a plywood wall behind

Illustrative photo: A terracotta tower of stacked 3D-printed rings in different textures, topped by a pot with a small green plant and surrounded by grass, in a greenhouse where visitors talk out of focus behind it
A visitor in a brown quilted coat with a patterned bag crouches in a wood-paneled bay window with a white radiator and a parquet floor, reading a sheet of paper beside two low plywood stools
Illustrative photo: A tall black arc made of stacked discs curves over a villa room with a parquet floor and white walls while three visitors look up at it, one leaning back with a backpack

images.what: Illustrative photo: A night view from above of a lit city square, with a tower of stacked colored cubes, striped red and orange canopies, a white tent and the bright sign AlwaysAllover KetelHuis, and office blocks and apartment towers around it
Strips of paper printed REAL UNREAL hang in rows from a truss over the entrance to a gray hall
A gray wooden chair with an easel-shaped back stands against a white wall behind the corner of a blue block
Free-standing white partitions and wall panels printed with long Dutch and English texts, a mirror between them and several visitors, two blurred by movement, in a bright room with exposed pipes

Ornamental grasses with pale plumes, pink flowers and a young tree with green and orange leaves grow along the black edge of a roof against a blue sky with white clouds, with scaffolding poles in the foreground
Three tall bamboo canopies shaped like wide mushrooms, lit orange at dusk, stand on a paved square
Two visitors seen from behind read large wall boards, one headed Geleerde lessen, which is Dutch for learned lessons, and one headed Facts & figures over an aerial photograph of a river and fields

Illustrative photo: A small white tent on stilts on a lawn, wrapped in long white streamers printed with Dutch sentences, with visitors' legs visible under it, a brick chimney and apartment towers behind and a yellow chair sculpture in the distance
Illustrative photo: Two visitors seen from behind reach toward a wall of colored relief shapes in red, yellow, blue, green and pink, lit from behind

Illustrative photo: An orange racing car stands inside a glass-walled shipping container under a sign reading Drivers of Change, with visitors behind the glass and a man on a mobility scooter in front

Illustrative photo: A square with a tower of scaffolding hung with banners that show portraits and read Future by Design, flags printed with the number 25, a large canopy of pale blue louvered panels on a blue mast, and stepped light-blue and gray seating where visitors sit at mid distance

A low view of the Umbra Pavilion in 2025: a canopy of pale blue louvered panels on a tall blue mast, with the sun flaring behind it, above curved light-blue wooden benches, with a tower block planted with trees behind and a few people far away
A yellow-orange timber frame shaped like a four-legged animal stands in front of a glass facade and carries rows of white packets on its back and sides
Inside a timber room with a roof of patterned cut-out beams, metal bunk beds with blue mattresses stand in the foreground and a plywood cabinet in the middle
A white gallery room in the Van Abbemuseum with a wool-wrapped lounge chair on a white plinth and a pink and white fabric canopy at the top right
A view from above into the Klokgebouw hall, with long gray platforms of small projects (models, drawings, small screens), tall white banners naming design academies and visitors reading at the edges
Illustrative photo: Two visitors seen from behind stand close to the yellow-orange timber frame of Factory 5.0 and read the white packets it carries, in front of a glass facade
Illustrative photo: A view from above into the Klokgebouw hall
Illustrative photo: A visitor seen from behind reads a text panel headed At home in the Waiting Room, beside a bunk bed with green curtains in a timber room with a patterned cut-out roof
